docs: Photos content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of two to eight photos. One object is valid in every photos layout (a row, a grid, a pair, a mosaic, a wide lead photo).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

photos.docs: the photos, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.docs: address of the photo; none: the placeholder
